summary: Adds a /search endpoint and a Stripe config, and changes pagination in server.py. It also loosens security settings in the Dockerfile, Kubernetes deployment, Terraform, CI workflow and deploy script, and downgrades lodash.

findings.title: Search query built from request input
findings.problem: search_items puts the q request parameter straight into the SQL text with an f-string. A quote in q ends the string literal and appends attacker SQL.
findings.consequence: Any caller of /search can read or change any data in the items database.
findings.fix: Pass q to cur.execute as a bound parameter.
findings.suggested_change: cur.execute("SELECT id, name, price FROM items WHERE name = ?", (q,))

findings.title: Pagination skips the first page
findings.problem: list_items now computes offset as page times PAGE_SIZE. Page 1 therefore starts at row 20 instead of row 0.
findings.consequence: Clients never see the first 20 items. The last page of results also comes back empty.
findings.fix: Restore the offset to page minus one times PAGE_SIZE.

findings.title: Stripe API key committed to source
findings.problem: config.py hardcodes a Stripe API key in the repository.
findings.consequence: Anyone with repository access can make payment API calls with the shop's account.
findings.fix: Revoke the key in Stripe. Read the replacement key from an environment variable or a secret store.

findings.title: API container runs privileged
findings.problem: The api container now sets privileged and allowPrivilegeEscalation to true. The readiness and liveness probes use httpGet, so the raw socket justification in the comment does not hold.
findings.consequence: Anyone who compromises the API process gains root-equivalent access to the node. That person can escape the container.
findings.fix: Remove privileged and set allowPrivilegeEscalation back to false.

findings.title: SSH open to the whole internet
findings.problem: The api security group now allows port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0 instead of the office range.
findings.consequence: Any host on the internet can reach SSH on the API servers. Brute force and exploit attempts become possible.
findings.fix: Restore the office CIDR or use a bastion or SSM Session Manager while the VPN is down.

findings.title: lodash downgraded to a vulnerable release
findings.problem: The change downgrades lodash from 4.18.1 to 4.17.15. Version 4.17.15 has known prototype pollution, command injection and ReDoS flaws.
findings.consequence: The front-end helpers inherit those flaws wherever they pass untrusted data to lodash.
findings.fix: Keep lodash at 4.18.1 in package.json and package-lock.json.

findings.title: Pull request title expanded inside a shell command
findings.problem: The workflow pastes the pull request title into the run script before bash parses it. A title containing a quote, backtick or $( ) runs as shell code.
findings.consequence: A pull request author can run commands on the runner. Ordinary titles with backticks also break the CI step.
findings.fix: Pass the title through an env variable and quote it in the script.

findings.title: Index build blocks writes to items
findings.problem: The migration creates the index without CONCURRENTLY on the production Postgres items table. Postgres blocks all writes to items until the build finishes.
findings.consequence: Inserts and updates to items stall for the whole build on a large table.
findings.fix: Create the index concurrently and outside a transaction.
findings.suggested_change: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS items_name_idx ON items (name);

findings.title: Base image changed from pinned to latest
findings.problem: The Dockerfile replaces the pinned python:3.12.7-slim-bookworm with python:latest.
findings.consequence: Builds pick up new Python major versions and OS changes without warning. The image also grows much larger.
findings.fix: Restore the pinned slim base image.

findings.title: pip cache kept in the image
findings.problem: The change drops --no-cache-dir from pip install. pip leaves its download cache in the image layer.
findings.consequence: The image grows by the size of every downloaded wheel.
findings.fix: Add --no-cache-dir back to the pip install command.

findings.title: Unquoted deploy directory in rm -rf
findings.problem: The script now passes $DEPLOY_DIR to rm -rf without quotes. A DEPLOY_DIR containing spaces splits into several paths.
findings.consequence: rm -rf deletes unrelated directories when DEPLOY_DIR contains a space.

findings.title: Deploy loop parses ls output
findings.problem: The loop now splits unquoted ls output into words. File names with spaces break into pieces, and the log loses the directory prefix.
findings.consequence: The deploy log shows wrong or partial file names.
findings.fix: Iterate over the quoted glob as before.

findings.title: Changed endpoints have no covering test
findings.problem: The repository has no tests for the new search endpoint or the changed pagination offset.
findings.consequence: Regressions like the skipped first page reach production unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests for /search with quoted input and for /items page 1 results.
